name: Pride or Prejudice
source:
Play this beloved tale of romance, snark, and self discovery, but with your choice of gender and appearance, and a few other fun choices along the way. 

[From [url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/pride-or-prejudice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亲历这个备受喜爱的故事，其中有浪漫爱情、挖苦打趣，也有对自我的探索。性别和外貌任你选择，一路上还有好些有趣的决定等着你做。

［摘自[url=https://spiralatlas.itch.io/pride-or-prejudice]itch.io[/url]］
